import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.LocalizedModule.Submodule
import Mathlib.RingTheory.OrderOfVanishing.Basic

/-!
# Localization of a principal quotient

The localization of a module presented by one equation is the localized ring
modulo the image of that equation.  This identifies Cartier quotient stalks
and their local lengths.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace IsLocalizedModule

variable {R S N : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [AddCommGroup N]
  [Algebra R S] [Module R N] [Module S N] [IsScalarTower R S N]

/-- A principal quotient localizes to the quotient by the localized equation. -/
noncomputable def principalQuotientEquiv (p : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization p S]
    (a : R) (f : (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a}) →ₗ[R] N) [IsLocalizedModule p f] :
    (S ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap R S a}) ≃ₗ[S] N := by
  have h : (Ideal.span {a} : Ideal R).localized' S p (Algebra.linearMap R S) =
      Ideal.span {algebraMap R S a} := by
    change (Submodule.span R {a}).localized' S p (Algebra.linearMap R S) =
      Submodule.span S {algebraMap R S a}
    rw [Submodule.localized'_span]
    simp
  let e := (IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv p
    ((Ideal.span {a} : Ideal R).toLocalizedQuotient' S p (Algebra.linearMap R S))
    f).extendScalarsOfIsLocalization p S
  exact (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ h.symm).trans e

/-- The comparison preserves residue classes of elements of the original ring. -/
@[simp] theorem principalQuotientEquiv_mk (p : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization p S]
    (a : R) (f : (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a}) →ₗ[R] N) [IsLocalizedModule p f] (r : R) :
    principalQuotientEquiv p a f (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap R S r)) =
      f (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ r) := by
  simp only [principalQuotientEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply]
  change (IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv p
    ((Ideal.span {a} : Ideal R).toLocalizedQuotient' S p (Algebra.linearMap R S)) f)
    (((Ideal.span {a} : Ideal R).toLocalizedQuotient' S p (Algebra.linearMap R S))
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk r)) = _
  exact IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv_apply _ _ _ _

/-- The length of a localized principal quotient is the local order of its equation. -/
theorem length_eq_ord (p : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization p S]
    (a : R) (f : (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a}) →ₗ[R] N) [IsLocalizedModule p f] :
    Module.length S N = Ring.ord S (algebraMap R S a) :=
  (principalQuotientEquiv p a f).length_eq.symm

end IsLocalizedModule
